findings: A detached async loop launches syncInterval(...).then(successHandler) without a rejection handler.
The yielded-results loop has no try/finally cancelling or joining the detached producer when its consumer returns early.
The producer interval generator is not closed when the result generator reports done.
scope: These static observations are not a reproduced failure/hang. Native explicit error propagation, cancellation and joining are a safety extension, not claimed exact equivalence to this source failure behavior.
